setupGuide.title: Connect Happy SMS

steps.title: Open the Happy SMS administration space

steps.title: Find your API key
steps.description: Open the API section in the administration space and copy your Happy SMS API key. The official documentation states that API requests use the X-API-KEY header.

steps.title: Paste the API key into MindCloud
steps.description: Return to MindCloud and paste the copied key into the API Key field for this connection.

steps.title: Save and test the connection
steps.description: Save the connection. MindCloud will use the same key for draft runtime validation through the Get Balance action.

name: Hub Planner

authentication.name: API Key
authentication.description: Use a Hub Planner API key generated from Settings > API. Hub Planner requires the raw key in the Authorization header without a Bearer prefix.
authentication.notes: Hub Planner documentation says to send the generated API key directly as the Authorization header value and explicitly not to prefix it with Bearer.

steps.title: Open API settings in Hub Planner

steps.title: Enable API access
steps.description: Enable API access for the account if it is not already enabled.

steps.title: Generate an API key
steps.description: Generate either a Read Only or Read & Write API key depending on the actions you plan to run.

steps.title: Paste the API key into MindCloud
steps.description: Copy the generated key and paste it into the API Key field. Do not add the word Bearer; Hub Planner expects the raw key only.
